## Purpose
Allows every crawler (named Googlebot, Bingbot, Twitterbot and facebookexternalhit, plus `*`) on every path. It is also the Docker health-check target.

## Accuracy
Accurate.

## Used by
Crawlers, and the frontend Dockerfile's HEALTHCHECK.

## Replication notes
Keep the file. The container's health check fetches it.
